transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well... I guess I'm here because of my eating habits. Sometimes in the evenings, after work... I just eat more than I should. Like, I'll be really careful during the day, but then at night, I might have dinner, and then... maybe some cereal, crackers, whatever leftovers are around. Sweets. Just... a lot, all in a short amount of time.
Do you feel like you can't control yourself or stop eating once you start during these evening episodes?

I suppose... yeah. It's just... once I get started on those nights, I kind of just keep going back to the kitchen. Even when I'm telling myself I should stop... I just, I don't really feel like I'm in charge of it again until I'm already uncomfortably full.
After these episodes where you eat more than you intended, do you ever make yourself vomit, use laxatives, or exercise a lot to try to compensate or control your weight?

No... I don't make myself throw up or take pills like that. I just... I guess the next day I try to make up for it. Like, I'll skip breakfast and lunch. Or I'll go for a really long hike, or push myself harder at softball conditioning... even if I'm already pretty tired.
When you have these episodes where you eat more than you intended, do they usually happen in a short window of time, like within a couple of hours?

Yeah... I suppose so. Like I said about the dinner and all those snacks... it usually all happens in, I don't know, a couple of hours. Once I get home from work, it just... it all happens in that short window.
During these episodes, do you feel like you're not in control of your eating, like you can't stop even if you want to?
Um... yeah. I think I mentioned that a minute ago. Like I said, I just... I don't feel like I can stop once I get started. I don't really know how else to explain it.
How often do these episodes where you feel out of control with your eating happen? Are they at least once a week?

Um... yeah, I guess so. For the last few months, it's been... most weeks, I suppose. Usually just one or two nights where I end up eating way more than I planned. And then... well, the next day I just do what I said before. I skip my meals, or... exercise a lot longer to try and make up for it.
